04 · Check it · what one deck costs in tokens

Skill plus edit-in-page cuts one deck from 148M tokens to 2.3M, about 64× less

ProofTokens per deck: build + 5 number changes 1 square = 1M tokens

64×fewer tokens per deck: 148M with chat, 2.3M with the full skill and edit-in-page
So whatScale

Write each new deck rule into the skill. Change numbers in the page. Ask Claude only for new layouts.

Driver · why

Each Claude step resends the whole chat, 105K–180K tokens. Cost = steps × context. A number fixed by Claude takes 8–10 steps (~1.5M). Fixed in the page: 0 steps.

Result→Proof→Driver→So what

Build by chat: this session’s usage log, Oct 17 2026 (~200 steps). Full-skill build (15–20 steps) and per-fix cost are estimates. Most input tokens are cache reads, billed at about a tenth of normal input.

05 · Ground rules

The skill builds the slide. Session 1 still decides what goes on it.

01

Write your HAT first. The skill needs a headline to put in the title.

02

Result, proof, driver, so what. Check every number against the source.

03

Every red gets an owner and a date. If you don't have them, the slide isn't ready.
